_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro: Kuna da Mai kunnawa {player_id} a cikin wasan Liar's Dice na {num_players}-mai kunnawa. Dokoki: - A lokacin da kuka juya, zaku iya: 1) Yi sabon tayin tare da adadi mafi girma ko fuska mafi girma (ko duka biyun) fiye da tayin na yanzu; watau '[Bid: 3, 4]', 2) Kira na ƙarshe ta hanyar buga '[Call]'. Idan kun kira: - Idan ainihin ƙididdigar wannan ƙimar fuska a cikin duk dice ya fi ƙasa da tayin, mai ba da kyauta na ƙarshe ya rasa ɗaya. - In ba haka ba, mai kiran ya rasa ɗaya. An cire ɗan wasan da ya kai 0 dice. Mai kunnawa na ƙarshe ya ci nasara.

board.new_round: Sabuwar zagaye - Ragowar dice: {dice_summary} Dice dinka na yanzu sune: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} calls! The actual count of face {face_value} is {count}, which is LESS than {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (the last bidder) loses one die.
call.caller_loses: Mai kunnawa {current_player_id} kira! Lambar fuska ta ainihi {face_value} ita ce {count}, wanda shine >= {quantity}. Mai kunnawa {loser_id} (mai kira) ya rasa daya ya mutu.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Kira da aka yi ba tare da wani tayin da ya gabata ba.
invalid_move.invalid_bid: Ƙimar da ba ta da inganci: {reason}
invalid_move.not_recognized: Aikin ba a tantance shi a matsayin ko aikin '[Bid: X, Y]' na multiplicand ko '[Call]'. An gabatar da aiki: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Sabuwar adadin {new_quantity} ya fi na yanzu {current_quantity} ƙasa.
bid_reason.face_lower: Sabuwar darajar {new_face_value} ta fi ƙasa da halin yanzu {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Farashin daidai yake da farashin da ake bayarwa a yanzu.
bid_reason.face_range: Lambar da aka ambata dole ne ta kasance tsakanin 1 da 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: An cire mai kunnawa {player_id} ta hanyar motsawa mara inganci.

outcome.win: Mai kunnawa {winner} ya ci nasara! Matsayi na ƙarshe: {final_ranking}
